core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Humair corresponds to the Arabic form حمير (Arabic root ح م ر (ḥ-m-r); حُمَيْر (Ḥumayr)). Its core sense is little donkey; diminutive form. The source gave حُمَيْر and glossed the name 'Lion-like'; حُمَيْر (Ḥumayr) is the diminutive of حِمَار (ḥimār, 'donkey'), which is not a positive naming sense, and the source gloss is unsupported. No confident meaning is asserted.
